about_the_game:
A Narrative Roguelike about Chaos and Cosmic Discovery

In Veilbreaker you find yourself in the K2-18 star system, where everything has collapsed. You fight against rising entropy - a creeping force destabilizing reality itself. You are a fragment of resistance in a broken world, tasked with rediscovering forgotten truths and stabilizing the timeline by uncovering fragments of story.

In this retro-inspired roguelike bullet hell, you increase the world level to face greater threats— but with them comes more entropy. Search for lore events that provide narratively charged moments and reveal what truly happened.

Key Features:

  • Story-driven progression
    Discover lost civilizations and explore an entropy-filled adventure with dystopian tales as you strive to reach the true ending.

  • Permanent upgrades
    Harness your powers! With each use you can achieve new permanent levels, unlocking new narrative paths with every attempt.

  • Entropy system
    The higher your world level, the more chaotic and difficult your runs become. Stabilize by uncovering lore events.

  • Roguelike core
    Customize your run by upgrading your powers and strategizing with your items— or give up and start anew.

Will you restore what was lost— or let the void take over?

This is a game for those who love mystery, challenge, and mechanics with deeper meaning. If you’re drawn to story-focused roguelikes with high replay value and cosmic stakes— then your story begins here.
